messages.subject: Error in nedist function
parts:
Hey Murray, 

I'm trying to calculate non-euclidean distances from certain locations to points in my habitat mask, to use as a mask covariate for modelling density in my study area. in my study area I have a large number of large lakes that impede movement, and 'as the crow flies' distances aren't sufficient. 

I've got the list of xy coordinates of the locations of interest, and two mask objects. 

Large_Campground <- Shapefilenowetland[Shapefilenowetland$vegForm == "Large Campground", ]

x_coord <- st_coordinates(Large_Campground)[, "X"]
y_coord <- st_coordinates(Large_Campground)[, "Y"]

Large_Campgroundxy <- data.frame(x = x_coord, y = y_coord) 

Study.Area.Mask.MLNP.2023session1 <- make.mask(traps1, type = 'trapbuffer', poly = Shapefilenowetland, buffer =14000, keep.poly = F, nx = 128, ny = 128) 

Study.Area.Mask.MLNP.2023session1coarsermask <- make.mask(traps1, type = 'trapbuffer', poly = Shapefilenowetland, buffer =14000, keep.poly = F, nx = 50, ny = 50) 

userdLargecamp <- nedist(Large_Campgroundxy, Study.Area.Mask.MLNP.2023session1coarsermask , Study.Area.Mask.MLNP.2023session1)



When I run this code, I get the error: 
Error in h(simpleError(msg, call)) : error in evaluating the argument 'x' in selecting a method for function 'extent': ‘srs’ is not a slot in class “BasicRaster”



I've tried googling the issue and it seems to be a niche problem, a few people ran into issues with it in the gdistance package, and they said re-installing packages fixed the error. However I've tried this and still getting the same error. 

I also tried making a mask with a 'non-habitat' shapefile, and setting 'poly.habitat' to false, but still getting the same error. 

Any advice would be much appreciated, 

Thanks very much, 
Brendan

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: Error in nedist function
parts:
I've seen that error message, but can't remember what triggered it. The 'secr' code in  secr-noneuclidean.pdf still works, as does a simple example (below). My best guess is that there is some clash with another loaded package, so I would suggest taking the simple example and adding stuff until it fails. If you find something let us know!
Murray

library(secr)

traps1 <- make.grid()
mask1 <- make.mask(traps1, nx=16)
mask2 <- make.mask(traps1, nx=32)
set.seed(123)
pts <- data.frame(x = runif(5), y = runif(5)) * 200
nonhabitat <- cbind(x = c(163,47,14,101,154), y = c(54,158,71,9,27))
mask1 <- subset(mask1, !pointsInPolygon(mask1, nonhabitat))
mask2 <- subset(mask2, !pointsInPolygon(mask2, nonhabitat))
plot(mask2)
points(pts)
ne <- nedist(pts, mask1, mask2)

par(pty='s')
plot(edist(pts,mask1), ne)  # as expected
